rows.grounds: Optative verb expressing injunction to perform worship.
Qualifies the devotion as highest or supreme.
Instrument denoting the attitude accompanying worship.
Instrument denoting the ritual formula used in worship.
Demonstrative specifying the particular mantra to be used.

items.question: By what means and attitude should worship be performed, O fortunate one?
premises: Worship is enjoined as the prescribed action.
Supreme devotion must accompany the worship.
This specific mantra must be employed in the worship.
items.inference: Therefore, one should perform worship with supreme devotion using this mantra.
uncertainties: The object of worship is not explicitly named in this verse and relies on context.
The referent of 'this mantra' is not specified within this verse.
items.plain_english: O fortunate one, one should worship with supreme devotion using this mantra.
